label: Efficient-priority controls: non-efficient participation and nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed finite controls: there are interpretations over Bool such that (1) participated beings have distinct esse, the mode-unspecified q.3 a.4 conclusion STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE and the mode-unspecified participation premise STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE hold, the component-kinds premise, both act-priority premises (simple and at a first being) and non-overlap hold, and efficient-cause priority holds for the efficient relation at esse, while efficient-cause priority read over the mode-unspecified CausesIn fails, the efficient q.3 a.4 reading and the efficient participation premise fail, and some component is a first being; (2) some component exists, every input of the efficient sibling routes holds and no component is a first being. Only these conjuncts are certified; the witnesses built in the proof (not part of the type) are, in (1), false a participated component of true whose esse true causes non-efficiently, with nothing prior to anything, and in (2), the same with true an efficient cause of false's esse and prior to it. 'Non-efficient' is a label for an unconstrained primitive: (1) shows that the efficient sibling's participation premise is not supplied by the mode-unspecified route and that the existing reading step (priority over CausesIn) asks more than efficient-cause priority does, not that non-efficient causes of esse exist.
